newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Petronas says minor Malaysian oil spill dissipates.
newsitem.headline: Petronas says minor Malaysian oil spill dissipates.

text.p: Malaysian national oil company Petroliam Nasional Bhd (Petronas) said on Thursday a minor oil spill of the Sarawak state coast had dissipated.
"Petronas is pleased to inform that the minor oil spill which occurred at its Betty-A platform offshore (state capital) Miri, Sarawak, has dissipated," the company said.
Petronas said the oil spill, which it estimated to contain around 150 barrels, was first noticed at 0800 local time (1200 GMT) on Monday, and resulted in two oil spill spots.
Production at Betty-A was immediately stopped on detection of the leak, said Petronas. The platform produces about 9,000 barrels per day of oil.
Helicopter and boat surveillance over the areas surrounding the Betty, Baronia, Bokor and Baram fields revealed that no oil sheen could be observed, said Petronas.
The source of the leak at the Betty-A production platform had also been contained said Petronas.
